name: analyzthis_design
description: 8 AI design personas — v2.7.0 mood board crops in any IDE + Kiro/Trae targets, v2.6.0 user-decided visual mood boards with scroll films, v2.5.2 motion/UX/visual library catalog and Kavi install detection, v2.5.1 anti-AI-slop craftsmanship, v2.5.0 signed rate-based persona trust scoring, v2.2 project-scoped knowledge bank, v2.0 chunked execution with frontier planner + free/cheap chunk models, adversarial deliberation loops, opt-in community feedback, Kavi knowledge collection, DesignSpec producer path, wireframe skills, UX critique, Agent Skills for Cursor, Claude, Codex, Grok, Windsurf. Plain source — no obfuscation, no auto-install.
author: Rishikesh Joshi

scripts.test: node scripts/test-accept.js && node scripts/test-share.js && node scripts/test-calibration-core.js && node scripts/test-chunk-quality.js && node scripts/test-calibrate.js && node scripts/test-calibration-community.js && node scripts/test-moodboard.js
scripts.test:dist: npm run build && node dist/bin/cli.js calibrate --dry-run --max-usd 1
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run validate
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run validate
scripts.postinstall:
node -e "console.log('
  analyzthis_design installed. Run: npx analyzthis_design --target all
  Or: npx analyzthis_design welcome
')"
